_comment: AF2-IG (AlphaFold2 monomer model_1_ptm as PXDesign runs it) configuration, read from ColabDesign 1.1.3, PXDesignBench and params_model_1_ptm.npz on 2026-08-20. Every value here was read from source or from the parameter file, not inferred. Plan: ~/.coworker/state/pxdesign-af2ig-port.md

runtime_semantics.recycle_mode: last -> cfg.model.num_recycle=0, host python loop of num_recycles+1 = 4 passes (colabdesign/af/design.py:147-205)
runtime_semantics.initial_guess: prev['prev_pos'] = inputs['batch']['all_atom_positions']; prev_msa_first_row and prev_pair start at zero (design.py:163-171)
runtime_semantics.bfloat16: global_config.bfloat16=True, bfloat16_output=False: params stored fp32 and cast on read, activations bf16 inside EmbeddingsAndEvoformer only; structure module and heads fp32 (config.py:305-306, modules.py:1387/1583, utils.py:29-44)
runtime_semantics.chain_break: single monomer model, two chains concatenated, residue_index jump of +50 (prep.py:223, prep.py:453)

dims.msa_rows_note: 1 design sequence + 1 appended template torsion row (modules.py:1531-1540)

metric_definitions.pLDDT: mean over BINDER of sum(softmax(plddt_logits) * bin_centers), 50 bins width 1/50 centred 0.01,0.03,...; logged as 1-loss (loss.py:188-194, design.py:113)
metric_definitions.pAE: sum(softmax(pae_logits) * bin_centers), bin_centers = breaks + step/2 with last centre extrapolated one step (loss.py:196-202)
metric_definitions.i_pAE: mean of pAE/31 over binder rows x target columns; unscaled_i_pAE = i_pAE * 31
metric_definitions.pTM_iPTM: confidence.predicted_tm_score: d0 = 1.24*(max(sum(w),19)-15)^(1/3) - 1.8, per-bin 1/(1+c^2/d0^2), weighted row-normalised mean, max over rows; i_pTM passes asym_id so pair_mask = asym_id_i != asym_id_j

reference_fixture.binder: first 80 residues of the same crop, translated +60 A in x, as chain B
reference_fixture.source: state/pxdesign-af2ig.md P2.3 (3 designs, identical values, deterministic)
